tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page itself: every screen's ground. Dark is night on the pond; light is goose-white paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Grouped content on `ground`: settings groups, the nav rail, the button-hint footer.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Things that sit above `surface`: secondary buttons, the focused or hovered row, menus and dialogs (with `shadow-overlay`).

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: input fields, toggle tracks, progress tracks, and the square behind a cover before its art loads.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that divide: between setting rows, around secondary buttons and cards. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that must be seen: toggle tracks, cycler and input borders, key-hint chips. 3.1:1 or more on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on every ground and on every `-soft` fill. The goose's white in the dark theme. 13.8:1 or more on `ground`, `surface`, `raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions under setting labels, a game's region · play time, timestamps, inactive nav items. 5.6:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholder glyphs only, never for text that has to be read (about 3:1).

tokens.name: beak
tokens.usage: Beak orange, the one accent. Fills the primary button, the on toggle, progress and the selected nav item's marker. Lay `on-beak` on it. Spend it once or twice a screen.

tokens.name: beak-hover
tokens.usage: `beak` under a pointer or while pressed.

tokens.name: beak-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text or a thin mark on a ground: the selected nav label, links, an active value. Dark: `beak` itself (7.2:1 on `ground`); light: a deeper orange (5.5:1 on `ground`).

tokens.name: on-beak
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `beak` and `beak-hover`: 7.4:1 and 6.3:1 on `beak` (dark, light). Never white on orange.

tokens.name: beak-soft
tokens.usage: A quiet orange tint: the selected nav item, the chosen option in a list. Text on it stays `ink`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, the brand's signature: a `focus-width` outline at `focus-offset`. 7.2:1 on `ground` dark, 5.5:1 light; 5:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Information and activity in progress (syncing, scanning). Icon `info` or `sync`; text in it on any ground or on `info-soft`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an info notice or badge.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done and safe: memory cards synced, a BIOS found. Teal, not green, so it never pairs with `danger` by hue alone; always with the `success` icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a success notice or badge.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a look but nothing is lost: offline, a sync conflict, a missing cover. Icon `warning` (a triangle).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning notice or badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Something failed or will be destroyed: sync failed, no BIOS, delete a save. Icon `error` (an octagon).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a danger notice or badge.

tokens.name: viewport
tokens.usage: The game picture's letterbox and the frame behind it, in both themes. Nothing else is pure black.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims what sits under a dialog or the pause menu.

tokens.name: osd
tokens.usage: On-screen messages over the running game (FPS, "State saved"): always dark, whatever the theme, because they sit on the game picture.

tokens.name: osd-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `osd`.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Fill of an on-screen touch button at rest, over the game.

tokens.name: touch-pressed
tokens.usage: Fill of an on-screen touch button while it is held.

tokens.name: touch-line
tokens.usage: Outline and glyph of an on-screen touch button.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the setup welcome, the library header on a TV.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section and dialog titles, a game's name on its detail page.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small section labels above a group, set in capitals by the component (write the text in sentence case).

styles.name: key
styles.usage: The glyph inside a controller or keyboard key chip.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pick the folder that holds your PS1 BIOS files.
styles.usage: Lead copy in setup and empty states.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Memory cards sync save by save between your devices.
styles.usage: Default reading text: notices, dialogs, descriptions that stand alone.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Descriptions under a setting's label, a game's meta line, captions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Anything you press or pick: buttons, setting labels, menu items, game titles.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Badges, nav items in a dense rail, the value in an option cycler.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Serials, timestamps, file paths, versions: anything compared digit by digit.

styles.name: osd
styles.usage: On-screen messages over the game. Tabular, so counters don't jitter.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside small things: between an icon and a badge label, a label and its description.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between an icon and a button label; between buttons in a row; between key-hint chips and their words.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding top and bottom; the gap between game cards in a dense grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button and row padding left and right; the gap between cards; a notice's padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog and panel padding; the gap between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen padding on desktop and handheld.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen padding on a TV (inside the overscan-safe area); space above a screen title.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty states and the setup welcome: room around the hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small and tight: badges, key chips, toggles, inputs, cover art, OSD messages.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, rows, notices, cards, settings groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the pause menu, bottom sheets on Android. Nothing in GooseStation is rounder: no pills, no circles.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus and the pause menu, the only things that float. Cards and rows never cast shadows.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons in dense desktop toolbars. Pointer only.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default button, cycler and row control height on desktop.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons and rows on touch screens and TVs: the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and dense rows.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, rows and notices.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in the nav rail, the pause menu and on TV; the icon set's drawing grid.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the `focus` outline. 3px on a TV.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus outline, so the ring never touches the fill.

tokens.name: line-width
tokens.usage: Hairlines and control borders.

tokens.name: toggle-width
tokens.usage: A toggle's track.

tokens.name: toggle-height
tokens.usage: A toggle's track; its square thumb is 16px, inset 4px.

tokens.name: cover-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest a game card gets; the grid fits as many columns as this allows (184px on a TV).

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The desktop nav rail.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the pause menu panel.

tokens.name: touch-button
tokens.usage: Each on-screen face button and D-pad arm on Android.

tokens.name: opacity-unavailable
tokens.usage: A game whose files can't be reached: its cover and title, until the folder is back.
